title: Grilled mackerel (saba shioyaki) with rice and sesame spinach
steps: Wash the rice and cook it with 160 ml water for 12 minutes.
Salt the mackerel on both sides, leave for 10 minutes, pat dry and grill for 8–10 minutes until the skin is crisp.
Blanch the spinach for 1 minute and squeeze out; toast the sesame, crush it and mix with soy sauce, sugar and the spinach.
Dissolve the miso in 400 ml hot water and add diced tofu.
Serve the mackerel with lemon, rice, spinach and miso soup.
